items.title: UnitedHealth Group (UNH) Expands Tennessee Health Hubs With $4 Million Commitment
items.summary: UnitedHealth Group expanded its Tennessee health hub initiative in partnership with the University of Tennessee Health Sciences. The program is growing from 5 to 13 locations with a new $4 million commitment. The expansion focuses on preventive care, support for chronic conditions, and rural health resources across the state.
